entry.title: New: Bill 138 (2023) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING ORDINANCE NO. 5530, BILL NO. 24, CD1 (2023), RELATING TO THE ISSUANCE OF GENERAL OBLIGATION BONDS OF THE COUNTY OF MAUI ISSUANCE, SALE AND DELIVERY OF SAID BONDS (DEPARTMENT OF PARKS AND RECREATION)" The purpose of the proposed bill is to amend Ordinance No. 5520, Bill No. 24, CD1 (2023), to add a new appropriation under the Department of Parks and Recreation for "War Memorial Football Stadium and Track Rehabilitation" in the amount of $3,620,000.
